text:
You need a bilingual virtual assistant who can handle phone, email, and chat support while keeping appointment booking and back-office systems organized across EMR, CRM, and email marketing tools.

Hi, I’m Mina Castellan. I have 5 years of experience in data analysis, dashboards, data cleaning, and data visualization, with strong skills in SQL, Excel, Power BI, and Google Sheets. While my background is analytical, that same attention to detail, comfort with structured workflows, and tech-savvy approach translates well to a fast-moving support role like this one. I’m comfortable working in systems, following processes carefully, and keeping information accurate and up to date.

I’m especially interested in roles where customer communication and operational accuracy both matter. For a healthcare startup, that means responding clearly and professionally to patients, helping them book the right appointments, and making sure records and messages are handled properly across your tools. I’m used to working with data entry, cleaning information, and keeping things organized, which is important when you’re moving between EMR, CRM, and email platforms throughout the day.

One project that reflects my approach was Shopify customer segments for Juniper & Ash Home. I built customer segments from Shopify order exports by recency, frequency, and spend, then fed them into the email tool. The top segment represented 9% of customers and 41% of revenue, and the email revenue increased by 19%. That work required accuracy, tool comfort, and a clear process for turning raw information into something usable, which is the same mindset I’d bring to supporting your booking and customer communication flow.

I also value clear communication and consistency, which are essential for a bilingual support role. If you need someone who can stay organized, learn your systems quickly, and help customers smoothly in both French and English, I’d be glad to contribute.

I’d welcome the chance to discuss how I can support your team.
